account.A login rule requires two-step verificat: A login rule requires two-step verification for your account. Turn it on to go on using Casvisor
account.Ask for a code from an authenticator app: Ask for a code from an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password after the password
account.Auto rotate - Tooltip: Casvisor changes the password on the asset to a new random one on schedule, through the asset's own account, which must be root, able to sudo without a password, or a Windows administrator. Only accounts with a password and no private key are rotated
account.Casvisor creates this account on the ass: Casvisor creates this account on the asset if it does not exist and sets the saved password there
account.Casvisor sets a new random password for: Casvisor sets a new random password for this account on the asset and keeps it. Connected sessions are not affected
account.Scan the QR code with the authenticator: Scan the QR code with the authenticator app, or enter this key
account.Successfully signed out, redirected to h: Successfully signed out, redirected to homepage
account.The account is set on the asset: The account is set on the asset
account.The two passwords do not match: The two passwords do not match
account.Then enter the 6-digit code it shows: Then enter the 6-digit code it shows
account.Users connect as these accounts without: Users connect as these accounts without seeing their passwords. The asset's own account above is the default account, and Casvisor uses it to change the passwords of the others

asset.API server - Tooltip: The address of the API server, like https://192.168.1.10:6443, with a path for a cluster behind a proxy; a host alone uses the port below
asset.Copied to the remote clipboard, press Ct: Copied to the remote clipboard, press Ctrl+V on the remote desktop to paste
asset.Copying files to the remote clipboard: Copying files to the remote clipboard
asset.Database - Tooltip: The database to open when connecting, can be left empty; for PostgreSQL an empty one means the database named after the user
asset.Files copied on the remote desktop: Files copied on the remote desktop
asset.Keep it running, then connect your clien: Keep it running, then connect your client to
asset.Namespace - Tooltip: The namespace shown first, and the only one shown when the token may not list namespaces; "default" when empty
asset.Network gateway - Tooltip: Connect to the asset through an SSH jump host or an agent in its network, for assets that Casvisor cannot reach directly
asset.Recorded on the first connection, a diff: Recorded on the first connection, a different host key or certificate is rejected afterwards. Clear it if the server was reinstalled or its certificate renewed
asset.The public key of the API server is reco: The public key of the API server is recorded on the first connection, a different one is rejected afterwards. Clear it if the cluster was reinstalled
asset.The remote computer is offline or can't: The remote computer is offline or can't be reached.
asset.The remote computer is showing the lock: The remote computer is showing the lock screen or a UAC prompt, which can't be shown here
asset.This browser can't decode the remote scr: This browser can't decode the remote screen, use a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari
asset.Token - Tooltip: A bearer token of the cluster, like a service account token from "kubectl create token"; its RBAC decides which pods can be opened
asset.Username of a Kubernetes cluster - Toolt: Optional, a name for the token, which permissions and sessions show
asset.Waiting for the person at the remote com: Waiting for the person at the remote computer to allow the session...

assetImport.A CSV file whose first line is the heade: A CSV file whose first line is the header. Only the name column is required; the protocol defaults to SSH and the port to the protocol's. Nodes are paths such as Beijing/Production, separated by ";", and missing ones are created
assetImport.An existing asset keeps the values of th: An existing asset keeps the values of the columns the file leaves out, and its password and private key when those cells are empty. Exported files have no passwords, so they can be edited and imported back
assetImport.Update the assets that already exist: Update the assets that already exist

assetNode.Group the assets into nodes, such as dat: Group the assets into nodes, such as data centers, environments or teams, and grant access to a whole node
assetNode.Nodes - Tooltip: The folders of the asset tree the asset is in. A permission on a node covers the assets in it and in all nodes below it
assetNode.Only a node without child nodes, assets: Only a node without child nodes, assets and permissions can be deleted
assetNode.Such as Beijing, Production or Databases: Such as Beijing, Production or Databases
assetNode.With no node chosen, the assets are take: With no node chosen, the assets are taken out of all nodes

login.Enter the 6-digit code from your authent: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
login.The login rule {{rule}} asks for a revie: The login rule {{rule}} asks for a review. Keep this page open; it signs you in once approved
login.The sign-in request is no longer valid: The sign-in request is no longer valid
login.Waiting for an administrator to approve: Waiting for an administrator to approve this sign-in

loginRule.Allow - Tooltip: Let the sign-in go on. Put an Allow rule before a broader Reject rule to make exceptions, such as the office network
loginRule.Client IPs - Tooltip: IPs or CIDRs such as 10.0.0.0/8; empty for every address
loginRule.Mfa - Tooltip: Ask for a code from an authenticator app. A user who hasn't turned it on must do so right after signing in on the web, and can't sign in through the SSH gateway until then
loginRule.Priority - Tooltip: Rules are tried from the smallest priority up, and the first rule that matches decides. Without a matching rule the sign-in goes on
loginRule.Reject - Tooltip: Refuse the sign-in. A rule that covers an administrator only through * or a group does not reject them, so that nobody can lock all administrators out
loginRule.Review - Tooltip: Hold the sign-in until an administrator approves it on the Login reviews page, 10 minutes at most. Like Reject, it does not hold an administrator through * or a group
loginRule.Reviewers - Tooltip: The administrators who may approve; empty for every administrator of the organization
loginRule.Sign-in methods - Tooltip: Web is signing in to the Casvisor website, SSH gateway is ssh, scp and SFTP through Casvisor; empty for both
loginRule.Time of day - Tooltip: Empty for the whole day. An end before the start, such as 22:00 to 06:00, goes over midnight and belongs to the day it starts on
loginRule.Time zone - Tooltip: An IANA time zone such as Asia/Shanghai; empty for the server's
loginRule.Users - Tooltip: Empty users and groups cover everyone
loginRule.Weekdays - Tooltip: The days the rule applies on; empty for every day
loginRule.With Casdoor sign-in, two-step verificat: With Casdoor sign-in, two-step verification is set in Casdoor, and this rule lets the sign-in go on

networkGateway.A computer running Casvisor Desktop conn: A computer running Casvisor Desktop connects out to Casvisor over HTTPS, a Desktop asset that uses it controls the computer
networkGateway.A token is set. It was shown only once,: A token is set. It was shown only once, generate a new one if it is lost
networkGateway.An agent in the other network connects o: An agent in the other network connects out to Casvisor over HTTPS and keeps the connection open, Casvisor reaches the assets that use the gateway through it
networkGateway.Casvisor connects to the gateway over SS: Casvisor connects to the gateway over SSH and reaches the assets that use it from there, the gateway needs AllowTcpForwarding
networkGateway.No token yet, generate one and start the: No token yet, generate one and start the agent with it
networkGateway.One network (CIDR) or IP address per lin: One network (CIDR) or IP address per line, the agent refuses to connect anywhere else. Leave it empty to allow every address
networkGateway.Recorded on the first connection, a diff: Recorded on the first connection, a different host key is rejected afterwards. Clear it if the gateway was reinstalled
networkGateway.The agent is disconnected right away and: The agent is disconnected right away and cannot connect again until a new token is generated
networkGateway.The agent using the current token is dis: The agent using the current token is disconnected and has to be started again with the new one
networkGateway.The token is shown only this once. Enter: The token is shown only this once. Enter these in the settings of Casvisor Desktop on the computer
networkGateway.The token is shown only this once. Run t: The token is shown only this once. Run the command on a machine in the other network, with the casvisor binary of the same release

Assets are not restarted automatically. Restart them afterwards if an update needs it.
patch.Connections to the assets drop while the: Connections to the assets drop while they restart. Each asset is scanned again once it is back.
patch.No SSH assets yet. Add the SSH asset of: No SSH assets yet. Add the SSH asset of a machine to manage its updates.
patch.Nothing has run on this asset yet: Nothing has run on this asset yet

permission.Accounts - Tooltip: Which accounts of the assets the users may connect as: the asset's own account, the account named like the user, all accounts, or accounts by username
permission.Nodes - Tooltip: Assets in these nodes of the asset tree and in all nodes below them, including assets added to them later
permission.The account named like the user: The account named like the user
permission.Time of day - Tooltip: Hours of the day the permission applies in, empty for the whole day. An end before the start, such as 22:00 to 06:00, goes over midnight
permission.Weekdays - Tooltip: Days of the week the permission applies on, empty for every day; sessions are disconnected when the window ends

sshKey.Connecting with your own username shows: Connecting with your own username shows a menu of your SSH assets

sshKey.The SSH gateway is not enabled, set sshG: The SSH gateway is not enabled, set sshGatewayPort in conf/app.conf to enable it

user.For a user who lost the authenticator ap: For a user who lost the authenticator app. The user signs in with the password alone and can set it up again
user.Leave empty to keep the password: Leave empty to keep the password
user.Password - Tooltip: At least 8 characters; leave it empty to keep the current password of an existing user
